name: Brook
effect:
[Opponent's Turn] If you have a total of 3 or more given DON!! cards, this Character gains [Blocker] and +3000 power.
(After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)

official_faq.question: Does the condition "if you have a total of 3 or more given DON!! cards" count both the DON!! cards given to this Character and the DON!! cards given to my other Characters and Leader?
official_faq.answer: Yes, it counts both the DON!! cards given to this Character and the ones given to your other Characters and Leader.

official_faq.question: My opponent declared an attack when I had a total of 3 or more given DON!! cards. They then used their [When Attacking] effect to remove another of my Characters with given DON!! cards from the field, causing my total number of given DON!! cards to drop to 2 or less. Can I still activate this Character's [Blocker] to block that attack?
